Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0aa9da1b313424b3bc667a00ccbaa08e9b93cd79`
Local-runs: none
Scope: examples/app-showcase/src/data/hooks/index.ts, examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts, examples/app-showcase/test/paid-invoice-line-lock.test.ts, docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json, .changeset/24684-showcase-paid-invoice-line-lock.md + packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (insert/update/delete hook dispatch, dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks, dispatchUnscopedMultiWriteHooks, triggerHooks, buildSession, claimReferentialCascadeDelete, cascadeDeleteRelations/walkReferencingRelations, assertReferencesResolve, executeWithMiddleware, ScopedContext.withRunAs), packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts, packages/objectql/src/hook-binder.ts, packages/objectql/src/hook-run-as.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts, packages/rest/src/error-response.ts, packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-data-door-code-prefix.test.ts, packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts, packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts, packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts, packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/runtime-identity.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-readonly-action-writes.ts, packages/formula/src/validate.test.ts, examples/app-showcase/test/task-reopen-hook-refusal.test.ts, examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts, examples/app-showcase/src/data/seed/index.ts, examples/app-showcase/package.json, .changeset/config.json, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, AGENTS.md

Read on the narrowing face, adversarially, from the card #24684 (body and all six comments: triage 6280795779, claim 6280841440, dispatch 6280866009, needs_decision 6281203874, ruling 6281609466, done 6282206376), #4889, #19853, the PR body and file list, the net diff against the merge-base `d20bf9b09b` (4 commits on the branch; 5 files, +381/-6, identical against current `origin/main` `0904d856e3`), and the head's check-runs, read 2026-10-20T03:15Z: 38 runs, latest per name 31 `success`, 6 `skipped` (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Dogfood shards, Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance), 0 `failure`, ONE still running at my read: `Test Core (1/6)`. `Check Changeset` (the pr-automation `changeset-check` job, which runs `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major`), `Build Core`, the four `Type Check` lanes, the eight `Lint` lanes, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, and `Test Core (2/6)` to `(6/6)` are green on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

**The three locks — right on every door that reaches `showcase_invoice_line`.**
- `beforeInsert` fires per row inside `engine.insert`'s middleware executor (`engine.ts` `executeWithMiddleware` at the insert site, then `triggerHooks('beforeInsert')` per row). Doors: `/data` POST by id and `/batch` `create` both go through `p.createData` with the caller's context (`batch-routes.ts`, the `trxCtx` comment: "carries the caller's context (including `isSystem`)"); an HTTP import writes each row through `runImport` → `p.createData` with the caller's context (`data-action-routes.ts` passes `context`; `core/utils/import-runner.ts` threads it); the inline grid saves through `/data` or `/batch`; a clone is an insert. Upsert: the engine has no `upsert` (`engine.ts` declares none; the sandbox facade's `upsert` falls back to `insert`), and the batch route's op set is `create | update | delete` — so an "upsert" is an insert or an update, both covered.
- `beforeUpdate` (the move): the by-id `update()` binds `previous` to the prior record and dispatches `triggerHooks('beforeUpdate')`; the predicate (`multi: true`) path reads the matched rows' pre-images and dispatches `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks('beforeUpdate', rows, …)` with `previous: row` and `input: { id, data, options }` per row (`engine.ts` `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks`). The flagged whole-operation dispatch (`dispatchUnscopedMultiWriteHooks`) runs only entries declaring `dispatchUnscopedMultiWrite`, which these hooks do not, and the per-row loop runs whenever `hasHooksFor` is true — a `multi: true` update with no `where` still dispatches per row. `/batch` `update` is `ql.update(op.object, { ...data, id }, { context: trxCtx })`, the by-id path. The condition `record.invoice != previous.invoice` is evaluated per dispatch against `pickRecordPayload` (stored ⊕ payload) and `pickPreviousPayload` (`hook-wrappers.ts`), so every repoint shape — by-id PATCH, predicate update carrying `invoice`, batch update — is seen; CEL heterogeneous equality is runtime-safe (`formula/src/validate.test.ts` "does NOT warn on heterogeneous equality (runtime-safe, returns false)"), so a null `invoice` payload does not fault the gate.
- `beforeDelete` (the remove): by-id `delete()` reads the pre-image, binds it and dispatches `triggerHooks('beforeDelete')`; the predicate path reads the `doomed` rows once and dispatches `dispatchPerRowBeforeHooks('beforeDelete', doomed, …)` with per-row `previous`; `/batch` `delete` is `ql.delete(…, { where: { id }, context: trxCtx })`, the by-id path. So `!ctx.previous` in the remove body is unreachable on these doors (it would only hold on the flagged whole-operation dispatch, which these hooks do not register for) — a harmless belt.
- **No un-refused shape found.** The one engine-level bypass is `session.skipAutomations`, which skips every metadata-bound hook (`triggerHooks`: `if (skipAutomations && entry.meta)`; the binder registers these hooks with `meta`). It is server-derived: `buildSession` projects it from the ExecutionContext, the batch route strips a body `context` ("keeps a body `context` from becoming the execution context"), and the import door refuses the `runAutomations: false` opt-out for every non-system caller ("An HTTP request is assembled with `isSystem: false`, so at the import doors every signed-in caller, administrators included, is refused", `import-prepare.ts`). It is therefore the same exemption as the system write, not a second door.

**The exemptions — each as wide as stated, with one width the dev understates.**
- `session.isSystem`: `buildSession` sets it iff the ExecutionContext carries `isSystem` (`engine.ts`), and `installRunAsApi` swaps `ctx.api` ONLY ("`runAs` is applied to `ctx.api` ONLY … the engine's own context object is never touched", `hook-wrappers.ts`), so the guards' own `runAs: 'system'` does not make the triggering write a system write. Producers on a running showcase: the seed (`SEED_WRITE_EXECUTION_CONTEXT = { isSystem: true, skipTriggers: true, seedReplay: true }`, `spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts`; `metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` `SEED_OPTIONS`) — needed, since `seed/index.ts` loads INV-1003 already `paid` and then its line; a script ACTION body's `ctx.api`, which is `buildActionExecutionContext(ec) = { ...ec, isSystem: true }` on both REST `/actions` and MCP `run_action` (`runtime/src/action-execution.ts`; the lint's own table in `validate-readonly-action-writes.ts` says "the action body is elevated BY DESIGN"); a flow declared `runAs: 'system'` (`service-automation/src/runtime-identity.ts`); a job body (`buildJobSandboxContext`, `body-runner.ts`); another hook's `runAs: 'system'` api or `ctx.api.sudo()`. An API key resolves to a user principal (`core/src/security/api-key.ts` writes as system only to `sys_api_key`); MCP data tools mint no `isSystem` (none in `packages/mcp/src`); an HTTP request is `isSystem: false`. **Does any open the paid lock to an ordinary user's request?** Not on the showcase as shipped: no action, flow or hook under `examples/app-showcase/src` writes `showcase_invoice_line` (only the seed, the object, a print page, translations and permission sets name it). But the dev's "the shipped seed is the one system writer" describes the showcase, not the exemption: a future showcase script action that writes a line would pass the lock by design. The hook header should say so in one clause; a follow-up, not a defect. Also a nit in the PR body: "The platform's own read-only strips exempt system writes the same way" is true of the STATIC `readonly` strip (`staticReadonlyStripRuns = !isSystem`) and not of `readonlyWhen`, which exempts no one (#9107 LOCK 2, as the lint file records).
- Cascade: `claimReferentialCascadeDelete` reads an engine-private `AsyncLocalStorage` token that only `walkReferencingRelations` sets, for exactly the child `object`/`id` it issues, claimed once ("Engine-private: nothing a request carries can name a record into it"); the child delete is the public `this.delete(childName, { where: { id }, context })` with the CALLER's context unchanged, so the remove guard runs as the ordinary user and the marker is the only thing that lets it pass; `body-runner.ts` copies the marker across the sandbox only when the engine set it `=== true`. A caller cannot set it (body `context` is stripped at the routes; `buildSession` builds field by field), and the branch is reachable only through a delete of the header, whose `cascade` relation issues the child delete. Exactly as wide as stated.

**The header read — right, and the "fail closed" claim holds in the way the prelude states it.**
- `runAs: 'system'` derives `ctx.api` via `ScopedContext.withRunAs('system')`, which is `this.sudo()` (`engine.ts`), gated by the declared `api.read` capability (`spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts`; `quickjs-runner.ts` installs the read methods behind `'api.read'`). So the verdict does not depend on the writer's read grants on invoices — needed, since contributors have owner RLS on `showcase_invoice` (`permission-sets.ts` `invoice_own_rows`).
- Disclosure: plugin-security is engine MIDDLEWARE (`ql.registerMiddleware`, three sites in `security-plugin.ts`), and `executeWithMiddleware` runs the middleware chain before the executor that dispatches hooks, so on the by-id doors the ADR-0055 master-derived write check (step 2.8, which covers `insert`) refuses a caller who cannot write the master BEFORE the guard reads; a caller the guard answers already could read the header, which is what `controlled_by_parent` implies. Residual, not measured and within tolerance: on a repoint the move sentence names no header, but if the destination header's writability is not judged before hooks (the security plugin's bulk path "returns early" with no single id), a caller who owns the source line learns one bit — that the id they named is paid — ahead of the reference check's own refusal. The sentence names no header and the write is refused either way.
- Not found: `paid()` returns `false` on a missing header, so the guard itself admits; the prelude says exactly that and defers to the engine's reference check, which runs for every non-system write on insert and on both update branches (`assertReferencesResolve`, three call sites) and refuses a dangling `invoice`. A delete or move-off of an orphan line is admitted, and no paid total exists to move. Right.

**The draft control — right.** The move guard's condition is false on an update that leaves `invoice` alone (`record.invoice` is stored ⊕ payload, equal to `previous.invoice`), so no header read is paid; the add and remove guards read once and admit a non-paid header. Pinned: draft insert, delete, move between drafts, plain edit.

**The pins — teeth confirmed from the code.** The five refusal pins assert `instanceof SandboxError` plus `innerMessage === sentence`, then the header's line count and `total` read back unchanged, on the production harness the reopen pin uses (real `ObjectQL`, `SqlDriver` better-sqlite3, `QuickJSScriptRunner` behind `hookBodyRunnerFactory`, the app's objects and hooks). With the three hooks removed from `allHooks`, each write resolves and `expect(err).not.toBeNull()` fails — five red, matching the dev's ablation count. The REVERSE case (`invoicesWithLines([])`) is a positive CONTROL: it binds no hooks and asserts the writes land, so it stays green under the ablation; what goes red is the five pins, which is what the PR body reports (5 failed, 7 passed). The wire: `mapDataError` unwraps `SandboxError.innerMessage` to `400` with `error` = the sentence and no `code` (pinned `rest.test.ts` "unwraps SandboxError.innerMessage → 400 with only the business message", and `rest-data-door-code-prefix.test.ts` "a sandbox refusal still answers 400 with the author's own sentence"); the `handleRouteError` arm in `error-response.ts` serves the same sentence on `/batch`, `createMany`, `updateMany`, `deleteMany`. The booted `400` + sentence in the PR body is consistent with that mapping. The showcase cannot import `@objectstack/rest` or `@objectstack/types` (not in its `package.json`), so pinning the envelope and reading the status on a boot is the right split.

**The comments — true about where each lock lives; one stale line beside them.** `invoice.object.ts`: "locks EDITS of a line, on the server too (the write drops the change)" (#4889; measured `PATCH quantity` 200 with the `readonly_when` drop), "insert-exempt by design" (`engine.ts` "INSERT stays exempt"), and "adding, removing or moving … locked … by the `showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_*` hooks" — all true. The hook module's new docblocks are true. NIT, not in the diff but made false by it: `GuardTaskReopenHook`'s docblock still reads "the showcase's one hook that REFUSES a write" (`hooks/index.ts`, the reopen guard's header); there are now four. Fix at the next touch.

### ② Semver level

- Package and level: `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `private: true` (`examples/app-showcase/package.json`), and `.changeset/config.json` has `privatePackages: { version: true, tag: false }`, so a changeset is owed and `patch` is the precedent grade for an unpublished package; nothing on npm carries the refusal.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` stands at the start of a line of its own in the PR body and in the changeset. `readClause2Line` anchors the key at line start (`CLAUSE2_KEY_LINE`) and reads the arm as the first token inside the parenthesis, tolerating the trailing prose (`clause2-line.mjs`, the "`no (narrowing — …)` reads the arm" rule); `check-changeset-no-major` carries the axis on a `no` with the `narrowing` arm. `Check Changeset` is green on this head.
- `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the changeset's single HTML-comment marker `adr-0087: not-required (unpublished) …` through its `not-required (category) why` regex, and `unpublished` is re-validated on every run as "every package the changeset bumps must be `private: true`" — the showcase is. It runs in pr-automation's `changeset-check` job, which is the green `Check Changeset`. The dev's reading "`not-required (unpublished)`" is right.
- Widening: none. The six new exports (three hook objects, three sentence constants) sit in the private showcase; the refusals throw plain `Error` sentences, so no `code` reaches the wire and no error code is minted; no spec key, no file under `packages/**`. The narrowing arm is honest: three writes the showcase accepted on `main` (POST 201, DELETE 200, PATCH `invoice` 200, all measured by the dev at `8e14ce0574`) are refused at this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, rev 7 — answered: every changed fact is true, no clause moved.** `allHooks` at the head has eight entries (normalize, stamp, reopen guard, the three paid guards, audit, warn); `showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_remove` is the one seeded `beforeDelete` hook; the throwing hooks are the reopen guard and the three paid guards; condition, `runAs:'system'`, `onError:'abort'`, `priority 60` match the module. Only `fixtures.requires[0]`, `knownGaps[1]`, `knownGaps[3]`, the `beforeDelete` entry of `variants`, `source[0]`, `revision` and the `changelog` moved; `steps`, `acceptance` and `negative` are untouched. Gate: `check:platform-checklist` is kept OUT of per-PR CI by maintainer decision (`lint.yml` NOTE; the daily `platform-checklist-watchdog.yml` on `main` is its reporting channel), so this file's gate verdict is the dev's local exit 0 among the 58 derived lines, not a head check-run — named here so the seat knows the watchdog is the backstop.
- **The cross-lane surface — escalated to the seat.** `docs/qa/**` is `domain:devx`'s (`pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, the lane table), and this PR is `domain:engine`; the claim 6280841440 did not declare the file. The only sanctioned channel is the second of three (SKILL.md: "认领席跟到底的越界面"), so before the queue the seat declares on the card, as a claim amendment: the widened file surface (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`, roster-only edit, the rev-3 precedent) and the in-flight intersection check against `domain:devx` claims and open PRs touching that file (the SKILL.md rule: read the `pm:dispatched` claims' file surfaces and intersect locally; serialise behind or yield on an intersection). The green `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` does not answer it: that gate judges declared single-writer paths only.
- **Code + status pins at the envelope, wire status on a boot — answered: accepted.** The mapping is the platform's and is pinned in `packages/rest` (above); the showcase pins the field that mapping classifies on (`SandboxError.innerMessage`). No deviation to escalate.
- **The cookie-jar file `cj-38921` — answered: absent from what lands; a dead credential.** Committed at the repository root in `6b269992` (5 lines) and deleted in `0aa9da1b`; `git diff merge-base..head --name-only` lists no `cj-*` and `git ls-tree -r pr/24731r` has none. `main`'s last eight PR merges each have exactly one parent, so the queue squashes: the landing commit carries the net tree and the file never reaches `main`; it survives only in the branch's own history. Content, read with the value redacted: a Netscape jar with one `#HttpOnly_localhost` `better-auth.session_token` (81 characters), a seven-day expiry — a server-side session reference for a `--fresh` localhost server whose temp-dir database died with the process, usable against nothing that still exists. The dev's account (a dead `--fresh` localhost session) is consistent with the file's shape. A history rewrite under AGENTS.md's five `--force-with-lease` criteria was denied by the permission classifier and not retried; the normal removal commit is the right fallback. Not blocking; delete the branch on merge as usual.
- **The stray `git checkout main` in the worktree — answered: nothing to escalate.** Not observable in the head or the diff; the branch's four commits are the fix, the ADR-0087 marker, the `origin/main` merge and the cookie-jar removal, and the net diff is the five files.
- **`open_questions`, both A (pass, built) — right on the four axes and in code.** System write: real need (the seed inserts INV-1003's line under an already-paid header, `seed/index.ts`); soundness (one `isSystem` posture across the engine's static strip, the import opt-out and this guard; `buildSession` is the single producer); against AI mistakes (stated in the prelude's docblock and pinned by `SYSTEM` fixture writes); startup focus (B reorders the seed for no consumer). Width caveat above: the exemption is every `isSystem` producer, action bodies included; none writes lines today. Cascade: the marker is engine-private and unforgeable, reached only by deleting the header; refusing would make a paid invoice undeletable through the API, a rule nobody asked for (the UI already hides Delete on paid rows, `invoice.object.ts`).
- **The out-of-scope finding (a hook refusal reaches `/data` with no `code`) — answered: the platform's declared shape, no filing gate met.** `rest.test.ts` pins it as a decision: "No `code` because this producer DECLARED none — not because the unwrap door withholds it … ADR-0112's half: nothing is invented for a half-declaration"; the sandbox passes a DECLARED `code`/`status` through (`quickjs-runner.ts` `SANDBOX_ERROR_PASSTHROUGH`), and the wire vocabulary is closed (`StandardErrorCode` ∪ `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER`), so a showcase hook cannot mint one. Carrying it in Acceptance notes is right; nothing to file.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24684-paid-header-line-lock`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`

**VERDICT: PASS**

### Seat note · `domain:engine` seat 1 · 2026-10-20T03:21Z

The seat checked the central claims on this head:
- the system exemption's width: `buildActionExecutionContext` in `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` elevates a script action's envelope with `isSystem: true` (#3914);
- the cascade marker: `claimReferentialCascadeDelete` in `engine.ts` is private, and its token is "Engine-private: nothing a request carries can name a record into it";
- the three guards' gates in `hooks/index.ts`: `ctx.session.isSystem`, `record.invoice != previous.invoice`, and `ctx.referentialCascadeDelete === true`;
- no `cj-*` file in the head's tree or in the net diff, and `main`'s PR merges land single-parent.

The claims hold.

**A serial constraint the record did not see.** PR #24714 (#24662, `domain:cli`, in the merge queue ahead of this PR) edits the same checklist item, `records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle`: it bumps `revision` 6 → 7 and appends a revision-7 changelog entry, as this PR does. `git merge-tree` of the two heads conflicts in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`. So this PR lands second, and it is held out of the queue until PR #24714 merges.

**Fix round 1** (sent to the dev when PR #24714 is on `main`):
- merge `origin/main`; keep #24714's revision-7 entry, and renumber this PR's item revision and changelog entry to 8;
- the record's two comment nits, in the same push: `GuardTaskReopenHook`'s docblock ("the showcase's one hook that REFUSES a write") is false now that there are four; and the paid guards' header says in one clause that any system writer passes by design (the seed, a script action's `ctx.api`, a `runAs: 'system'` flow);
- the gates re-run on the merged head.

The seat patches the PR body's sentence on the read-only strips: it is true of the static `readonly` strip only, not of `readonlyWhen`. A delta note follows the fix round, then the ACCEPT.

**Cross-lane:** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` is `domain:devx`'s. It is declared to that lane now, naming the intersection with PR #24714.
